steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Folds: anticlines (upfolds), synclines (downfolds), overfolds and recumbent folds, formed by compression

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Faults: normal (tension), reverse/thrust (compression), strike-slip (shear), identified by displacement of rock layers

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Joints: fractures with no movement, formed by cooling (igneous) or tectonic stress; columnar jointing in basalt

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Unconformities: angular (tilted older rocks overlain by younger horizontal beds), disconformity (parallel beds with erosion gap), nonconformity (igneous/metamorphic overlain by sedimentary)

steps.body: Three unconformity types: angular, disconformity, nonconformity Hutton's unconformity = deep time evidence, know the story Field identification: look for displaced marker beds across faults Map patterns: symmetrical repetition of beds = fold; offset of beds = fault
